text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer! I hope this
year will be
an auspicious one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My resolution? Hmm... Good question. I
haven't
thought of anything yet.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year! What's your resolu...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What about pulling a fortune slip with
the luckiest outcome? Wait, I'm pretty
sure that was my
resolution last year
too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about pulling a fortune slip
that says
"One more fortune, on the
house"?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Winning the grand-prize in a
raffle is pretty high on my list of goals
too. Howzabout
them for some
resolutions?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I just can't come up with anything
good.
What's a good resolution?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp?! You're right. I'm not a junior anymore. Then, what about...
choice_data_list: You're entering the Classic tier t...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I want to win some big race! I know
that's pretty
vague, but still.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Well, I guess I'm going with
that, then! Now that I've got a goal in
mind, it really makes
me want to put my
luck to the test.
choice_data_list: I think that's a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I know! I've got somewhere I want to
take you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, bet you thought I was talking
about a shrine. Sorry to disappoint, but
even the shopping district becomes a
place to test your luck around New
Year's.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look, lucky bags! Pick one, and we can
see if luck
is on our side this year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Which bag are you gonna choose?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The plastic bag? Oh yeah, that's the
only one
that's see-through.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You can already see what's inside, so
there's no
chance of ending up with a
dud! You never
disappoint, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That would have never occurred to me.
Wow, I
feel like my smarts just went up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why leave things to luck when there's a 
fool-proof method available to you? It
seems Matikanefukukitaru has learned a
valuable lesson
today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The super stuffed one? It definitely
looks like
they've packed a lot of things
inside. That's what
you want?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the bag and look inside...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's just a bunch of unsold food.
Snacks
close to their expiry date,
carrots, stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But I can practically smell the luck
coming from
this stuff! I'm sure it will
nourish our spirits, if not
our health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what exactly she's trying to
say... but
the food does seem to give her
some energy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Foot bags? Ohhh, you mean those socks
over
there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what's supposed to be lucky
about
them, but I guess it wouldn't hurt
to buy a pair...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Actually, they might give my stride
something special if I run in them. Let's
go for a New Year's
run and take 'em for
a spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have a new tool in our arsenal that
will broaden the scope of her running. I
have a feeling our future training
sessions will go a lot more
smoothly.
